name: Sanctum of the Flock

components.m: powdered silver worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: you and up to your spellcasting modifier (minimum 1) other creatures of your choice

summary: A 20-foot Sphere of shimmering light for 24 hours: you and chosen creatures who finish a Long Rest in it gain 2d10 Temporary Hit Points and Advantage on Charisma checks with skills they are proficient in for the rest of the 24 hours.
text: Over 1 minute you raise a 20-foot-radius Sphere of faint, shimmering light centred on a point within 5 feet; the powdered silver is consumed. You and a number of other creatures of your choice equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 1) can draw in its empowering magic. When any chosen creature finishes a Long Rest inside the Sphere, the Sphere vanishes and every chosen creature that finished that Long Rest in it gains 2d10 Temporary Hit Points and, for the remainder of the 24 hours, Advantage on Charisma checks that use one of its skill proficiencies. A chosen creature that did not finish a Long Rest in the Sphere gets nothing. (Code: a Long Rest hook that applies the Temporary Hit Points and a 24-hour effect; a cast-before-resting option on the rest screen.)
